mentions.name: PocketPMO
mentions.description: PocketPMO is a project management tool that lets users size, cost, plan, track, and report on multiple projects, with support for adding teams, managing stakeholders, registering risks, and tracking budgets.
mentions.audience: Founders, Project Managers and Project Manager Officers
mentions.source_excerpt: PocketPMO is meant for Founders, Project Managers and Project Manager Officers. It allows them to quickly size, cost, plan track and report on multiple projects. Teams can be added, Stakeholders managed, Risks Registered and Budgets tracked.
